title: Pre-existing coverage debt: main fails npm run test:coverage on every axis
description:

Measured on clean HEAD (WU-1 changes stashed): statements 92.28% (need 98), branches 87.08% (need 92), functions 80.6% (need 97), lines 93.83% (need 100). All four axes fail.

HOW TO APPLY: bring all four axes back to .coverage-thresholds.json levels (lines 100, statements 98, functions 97, branches 92). title: spike-sessions WU-8: 2-week post-merge usage check
description: Opened at WU-7 merge with a 2-week deadline. Operator records: (M1) number of times 'metaswarm-dashboard sessions audit' was run on real sessions in the 2-week window; (M2) number of fail/watch verdicts that caused a behavioural change (operator stopped a session, re-read transcript, rolled back a WU, opened a corrective bead, or adjusted a session's scope). Targets: M1 ≥ 5, M2 ≥ 1. If BOTH met → close as 'follow-ups proceed' and the follow-up beads (web view, cross-session aggregation, secret-pattern redactor) become eligible. If EITHER missed → close as 'follow-ups cancelled — reason X'; the follow-ups are explicitly cancelled (NOT deferred) per design §15.2; the rubric / CLI stay as-is or are reduced. This bead intentionally outlives the technical spike; it is the user-facing success criterion.

title: spike-sessions WU-4.5: calibration gate (HARD GATE before WU-6)
description: Validate the 9 rubric scorers against operator-declared ground truth on 2 real sibling sessions. Operator picks 1 known-good + 1 known-drifted session, labels expected verdict for each of the 9 scorers (= 18 labels). Run scoreTimeline on both sessions; compare verdict-by-verdict. AGREEMENT RULE: for each scorer, ≥80% agreement across the 2 sessions (i.e. agreement on both, or 1-of-2 with explicit written justification) → KEEP. <80% → DROP: delete the scorer module, remove from RubricKey enum, decrement ProcessRubricScore.items.length, update design §7 table. Deliverable: docs/sessions-calibration.md recording per-criterion label/verdict/agreement/decision. If labels would reveal proprietary detail from sibling repos, commit only counts and decisions. HARD GATE: WU-6 cannot start until this closes. KILL SWITCH: if <6 of 9 scorers pass, escalate to operator per design §15.3 — do NOT auto-ship a degraded rubric.
notes: Calibration RAN 2026-05-17 (agent-judged per operator delegation). Outcome: §15.3 calibration kill — all 7 smoke-survey sessions score overall:fail; only 5/9 criteria survive §9.4 in spirit. Bead stays OPEN until the operator records a §15.3 decision. Full record: docs/sessions-calibration.md.
close_reason: Superseded by design v4 (docs/design-sessions-spike-v4.md). §15.3 calibration-kill resolved: operator directed a re-scope — rubric demoted to advisory + 2 bug-fixes; calibration becomes a continuous dashboard rating UI. Decision recorded in docs/sessions-calibration.md.

title: spike-sessions WU-3: JSONL parser
description: Implement packages/sessions/src/jsonl-reader.ts exporting parseTranscript(filePath, fs?) → SessionTimeline. Pure, fs injectable. Per-line 1 MiB cap (skipped lines counted in SessionTimeline.skippedLineCount, NOT thrown). Tool-use summaries: Bash → first 120 chars of command; Read/Write/Edit → file path with repo prefix stripped; Agent → 'subagent_type: description[:80]'; others → tool name + key arg summary. Edge cases (per design Appendix B): B1 empty file, B2 single valid line, B3 single malformed, B4 mixed valid/malformed, B5 partial JSON at EOF (no trailing newline), B6 CRLF line endings, B7 leading UTF-8 BOM, B8 line >1 MiB (skipped + counted), B9 non-UTF-8 bytes (skipped + counted), B10 hostile keys (__proto__, constructor — Zod ignores extras; verify no downstream pollution). Synthetic fixture at __tests__/fixtures/synthetic-events.jsonl starts with the marker line enforced by WU-1's setup-file. Parity-with-PoC test asserts timeline matches synthetic-events.expected.json (frozen golden master).
close_reason: 4-phase loop complete: VALIDATE green (build/typecheck/test 369/lint), ADVERSARIAL REVIEW PASS 9/9 DoD. jsonl-reader.ts 100% coverage.

title: Typed multi-source activity on dashboard project cards
description: Today ProjectSummary.lastActivityAt is computed only from BEADS task closed_at/updated_at (collector/src/metrics.ts), so projects with recent git commits but no beads tasks render 'Never' — misleading. Add typed per-source activity (git last commit, beads, claude-code sessions) with a source badge on the card and a click-through detail drawer showing per-source breakdown. Claude/agent activity must CONSUME the sessions-spike output (packages/sessions) — not re-implement transcript reading. DEFERRED: start only after the spike-sessions WUs land. Process when picked up: /brainstorm -> design review gate -> plan. Scope: packages/collector, types, server, web.
